authorization: Human requests Gazebo truth pose/velocity based controller calibration across scenes and feedback frequencies; simulation only, separate from actual SLAM navigation validation.

minimum_architecture.entry_point: New independent worker receiving the unchanged native64 frame and running truth controller immediately before frozen CPU Teacher inference. Reuse load_actor/build_observation but do not change old worker/controller defaults or old source hashes.
minimum_architecture.joint_executor: Keep teacher_sim::TeacherActuator the sole JointForceCmd writer. Controller outputs only vx/vy/yaw_rate; no joint position/force writer, CHAMP or ros2_control.
minimum_architecture.feedback: Use received native frame directly. Avoid state.json (written once per 10 actor frames = only5Hz) or reading log files for control.
minimum_architecture.sample_clock: Fresh feedback update in simulation time from integer source physics timestamp, then zero-order-hold controller output between admitted samples; actor remains50Hz and physicalPD200Hz.
minimum_architecture.cannot_claim: Current socket exchanges are50Hz. A100Hz timer with repeated native frame is not100Hz effective feedback. A real100Hz test needs an independently reviewed native interface with actor still50Hz.
minimum_architecture.truth_label: Separate truth calibration manifest with truth_feedback_used=true, slam_navigation_integration_passed=false; do not forge source=scan_slam or pass actual navigation acceptance.
minimum_architecture.unchanged: Frozen checkpointSHA, actor architecture/observations/actionscale/jointmap/basePD/motor limits, bootstrap/learned zero-command stop, native200ms IPC fault and unique executor checks.

native_fields.state_time_s: s[0] -0.005, physical result from preceding5ms Physics integration
native_fields.position: s[1:4], world base link origin, m
native_fields.linear_velocity: s[8:11], base COM point velocity in full body orientation, m/s
native_fields.angular_velocity: s[11:14], full body-frame angular velocity, rad/s
native_fields.joints: s[14:26] positions, s[26:38] velocities, s[38:50] previous clipped actual applied torque, trainingFR FL RR RL hip/thigh/calf order
native_fields.contacts: s[50:55], native collision counts body/FR/FL/RR/RL, -1 means unavailable
native_fields.origin_COM_consistency: Do not pair origin position derivative with COM linear velocity silently. Native plugin knows comOffset; either choose COM position p_origin+R@offset and COM velocity for tracking, or subtract omega_world cross R@offset to obtain origin velocity. Record chosen tracked point.
native_fields.slope_transform: World linear velocity is full quaternion R@v_body, not only yawR. Body omega_z differs from Euler yaw derivative on roll/pitch: yawdot=(sin(roll)*omega_y+cos(roll)*omega_z)/cos(pitch). Record both, protect cos(pitch) singularity.

reference_design.route: Immutable prospective exact continuous world polyline with active segment ledger and explicit goal region/dwell. No SCAN replan, moving lookahead as hidden reference, or reset to current drifted robot pose.
reference_design.geometry: Project chosen tracked point continuously onto active finite line segment; retain signed along/cross-track error, endpoint distance and exact world trajectory for audit.
reference_design.space_vs_time: Primary path-following target is spatial: time-independent path geometry plus prescribed cruise speed. If timed trajectory is added, mark and score its separate along-track schedule error; do not mix definitions.
reference_design.desired_velocity: v_ref_worldXY = tangent*v_profile - normal*k_cross*e_cross, with explicit endpoint deceleration and terminal position control. Desired heading follows the same segment/path tangent; curves add curvature*v_profile yaw-rate feedforward.
reference_design.ramp: Keep XY/yaw servo; height and support clearance are safety/arrival evidence. Never apply vertical PID or interpret ramp connection as true stairs.
reference_design.terminal: Use explicit measured stop/dwell and slowdown at remaining distance; never freeze action or set action=0. Learned Teacher continues on zero velocity command.

controller_candidates.purpose: Replace only feedback/path reference in old P/I/D design to isolate localization/reference effects, keeping old gains for baseline.
Decouple along/cross coordinates, prescribe tangent cruise-speed feedforward, cross-track P plus measured lateral damping, no position integral initially; yaw angle P plus angular-rate damping.

Outer path/angle error produces target twist. Inner body vx/vy/yaw-rate error PI corrects Teacher response. Derivative is unnecessary initially because velocity signal has gait oscillations; do not double-count outer velocity damping.
controller_candidates.saturation: Command clamp per frozen training ranges[-1,1]vx,[-.4,.4]vy,[-1,1]wz plus stricter prospective speed/stage caps. Conditional/back-calculation antiwindup observes both slew and per-axis clipping; reset on stop/fault/new route-leg, not every sampled state.

experiment_order: 1. Freeze source/config/protocol and record CPU/GPU competition. Bare CPU physics screening, sensors/camera only selected actual verification to avoid changing load across candidates.

2. Open-loop Teacher response by axes and speed stages0.3,0.5,0.7,1.0m/s, positive/negative y and yaw, transition to learned zero velocity. Separate achievable speed/stop distance from PID performance.
3. Fixed straight6m and lateral offset recovery, bothdirections, heading offset±0.2rad. Compare three controller designs at10/25/50Hz with identical source phase/initial condition.
4. Select best tested feasible controller; tune one axis/gain at a time with prospective bounded small grid, then3repetitions of winner at speeds that cleared previous stage.
5. Heldout square/corner or smooth turn,12m up/down ramp and5/10cm step; failures retained separately. Multilevel navigation integration remains unverified.
6. Inject controlled command producer pause/timeout and stop/recovery; if inline controller used, distinguish internal safety semantics from actual bridge communication failure.
7. Freeze winning controller/config and prospective same tests, swap onlyfeedback to realSLAM plus causal IMU prediction; no truth-assisted route/arrival success claims.

flat_tracking.steady_window: Explicit post-acceleration interval≥3s, before endpoint slowdown; do not select favorable window afterwards.

proposed_new_criteria_must_be_frozen_bef.arrival: Endpoint radius0.15m with measured speed≤.03m/s and yaw-rate≤.05rad/s continuous.6s; deadlines scale by length/cruise speed plus predetermined turn and settle margin.
proposed_new_criteria_must_be_frozen_bef.parking: 5s fixed window after predetermined completion+settle; XYdrift≤.03m, yawdrift≤.10rad, preserve actor inference and zero requested/applied velocity command.
proposed_new_criteria_must_be_frozen_bef.ranking: Hard-gate feasibility first; among passed candidates rank prespecified normalized routeRMS+velocityRMSE+headingRMS+command total variation/overshoot with allrepeats; call best-tested parameters, never global optimal.
proposed_new_criteria_must_be_frozen_bef.validation_scope: These are NEW calibration criteria, not a change/reinterpretation of previous original navigation formal25checks.

logging_required: exact physics state timestamp and admitted source sequence
feedback update/held flag and actual intervals
pre/post slew and saturation plus antiwindup/reset reasons
Teacher applied command and actual body COM twist
material_risks: Current old HeaderPID and worker schedule caps are .3/.2/.3; must not silently widen established navigation scope.
A reference of1m/s and commandmax1m/s may be infeasible if Teacher undertracks; report infeasible operating point rather than windup/highergain fix.
Training command support includes1m/s but does not establish stable deployment performance.
Base link-origin position and COM velocity refer to different points; posture change causes a real angular velocity offset.
On ramp bodyomega_z is not exact worldEuler yawrate; fullorientation transform needed.
Current Teacher scan privileged+20raystart can see upperdeck; controller tuning cannot repair that scene-observation mismatch.
Task can identify best tested controller, not mathematical global optimal PID.
